system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you deal damage to a creature as a result of an attack while in Elemental Flux, you can block their chakra pathways by spending 1 Superiority Die. When you do, until the beginning of your next turn, jutsu that creature casts has its cost increased by twice the result of the Superiority Die.
